name: The bundle
subtitle: Drop the zip the other site produced, then press Read bundle. Nothing is written until you press Import, and Preview will tell you exactly what would change before you do.

elements.label: Bundle file
elements.hint: The upload lands in the public folder for a few seconds before this screen moves it somewhere private. Press Read bundle straight away rather than leaving the page open.

name: What to bring in
subtitle: Everything in the bundle comes in unless you name it here. Anything you leave out has its data file never opened, so narrowing an import is cheaper, not just smaller.

elements.label: Leave out
elements.placeholder: Nothing — bring in everything the bundle carries

elements.label: Passphrase, if the bundle carries credentials
elements.hint: Read bundle will tell you whether this one has any. Credentials are applied last, so a wrong passphrase costs nothing that already imported — they are skipped, you are told, and this site's existing keys are left exactly as they were.

name: When a record clashes
subtitle:
Sometimes a record in the bundle has the same identity as one already here — the same SKU, the same slug, the same discount code.

By default nothing is lost on either side: the incoming record is added alongside under a free name, and you can merge the two afterwards knowing you still have both. Nothing is ever silently dropped.

confirm.title: Overwrite this site's own records?
confirm.text: Where a record in the bundle has the same identity as one already here, the version on THIS site will be replaced by the one in the bundle. That is not reversible — only pages keep a snapshot you can go back to. Leave this off and nothing here is touched: a clashing record is added alongside under a free name, so no data is lost from either site.

elements.label: Overwrite my records when they clash
elements.hint: Overwriting also requires permission to update each resource, not just permission to run a migration.

name: Progress
subtitle: A large bundle takes more than one press. If it stops part-way the site is partly populated — press Import again to carry on, do not start over. Re-running is always safe: records are matched on their natural key, so nothing is written twice.

elements.label: What would change
elements.placeholder: Press Preview to see what this bundle would do.

name: What this will not do
subtitle:
No record in the bundle is ever discarded. If it clashes with one here it is either added alongside under a free name, or — when you turn overwriting on — it replaces the one here. There is no third option where something quietly disappears.

Every resource in the bundle is checked against your own permission for it. Being allowed to run a migration is not, on its own, permission to rewrite the catalogue.

Imported accounts arrive unable to sign in and with no role. A paid plugin's licence is bound to a domain, so plugins arrive needing re-licensing on this one.
